I Built a Complete Website in 10 Minutes — No Code, Just AI

New AI website builders can create entire sites from a single prompt. I tested the best ones. Here's what actually works and what still needs work.

The Experiment

I've built websites the traditional way for 20 years. HTML, CSS, some PHP when I was feeling spicy. Last week, I decided to see if AI could do it better. The answer: yes and no.

What Works

Speed. I generated a complete landing page in 10 minutes. Not a skeleton. A real, usable page with copy, images, and basic functionality.

Design quality. The designs are genuinely good. Not "AI art" weird, but actual professional layouts.

Iteration. Want to change the color scheme? Add a section? The AI handles it instantly. What used to take hours now takes minutes.

What Doesn't Work

Custom functionality. Need something specific? You'll still need code. AI builders are great for templates, not custom features.

SEO optimization. The AI doesn't understand SEO. You'll need to manually optimize.

Brand consistency. AI doesn't know your brand guidelines. You'll spend time adjusting to match.

The Verdict

AI website builders are ready for: landing pages, simple sites, MVPs, portfolios. They're not ready for: complex web applications, highly custom sites, anything requiring real backend work.

For my OpenYourAIs site, I still needed a developer. But for 80% of small business websites? AI builders are now a legitimate option.

Rating: 7.5/10 — Ready for mainstream use. Great for simple sites, still needs humans for complex projects.
